title: Autoregressive Conditional Heteroscedasticity with Estimates of the Variance of United Kingdom Inflation
supported_mechanism_claims: Past shocks can inform conditional variance even when mean returns are not autocorrelated.
Volatility clustering is distinct from reliable directional price prediction.
scope_note: Econometric motivation, not estimated BTCUSDT parameters or backtested position returns.

title: Modeling and Forecasting Realized Volatility
supported_mechanism_claims: High-frequency historical prices can support realized-variation measurements and forecasting frameworks.
Sampling, information availability and market microstructure noise matter for fine-scale realized variation.
scope_note: FX research motivates research measurements; this is not proof of BTCUSDT execution returns.

title: Volatility-Managed Portfolios
supported_mechanism_claims: Scaling risk exposure according to past volatility is a distinct strategy design dimension.
Historical risk-managed portfolio findings must not be transferred to BTCUSDT without registered execution, funding and cost tests.
scope_note: Asset-pricing/portfolio literature, not confirmation of a BTCUSDT volatility-timing trading strategy.
